reason: A DSH plugin that activates glob-scoped Markdown rules based on files touched by an agent and injects the matching rules into the conversation, primarily providing session context management.

summaries.zh: 根据智能体接触的文件匹配 glob 规则，并将适用的 Markdown 规则注入 DSH 对话以提供上下文。
summaries.en: Activates glob-scoped Markdown rules for files touched by the agent and injects the applicable rules into the DSH conversation as context.

capabilities: Reads project and user rule files
Tracks files touched by each agent session
Matches touched paths against glob patterns
Injects matching rule content into the agent conversation
Persists and restores rule snapshots through the session log
